title: BITCOIN & CRYPTO WARNING: Trading Signal Flipped!!! - Bitcoin News Today, Ethereum & Altcoins
speaker: Josh

macro_themes.view: Crypto funding rates slipping below neutral limit downside and raise short-squeeze risk for shorts.
A Nasdaq 100 ATH breakout when markets reopen would be bullish for crypto and could bring the next breakout sooner.
Expects chop/slight pullback for up to another week, larger bull trend intact.

short_term.horizon: coming days / up to a week

calls.condition: If Nasdaq breaks to new ATH in the new week, crypto breakout could come sooner.
calls.reason: Still capped at 86-88k with daily bearish divergence; liquidity both above (85.3k, 87.3-87.5k) and below (82.7-82.8k, 81k) so expects range chop hitting both.
calls.quote: it's actually somewhat likely that we could ultimately hit both of upside and downside liquidity levels in the coming days

calls.condition: If breakout above 2.8k confirmed, next target ~3.3k.
calls.reason: Rejection at 2.8k with daily bearish divergence; slight pullback/chop expected but negative funding limits downside.
calls.quote: Not necessarily a huge crash, but basically the price action we've been seeing already for close to a week now to continue

calls.condition: Would re-short if funding turns back positive while divergence holds, or after a push higher reconfirms the divergence.
calls.reason: Closed XRP short in profit: negative funding rates and a possible Nasdaq ATH breakout pose short-term upside risk.
calls.quote: due to some of those reasons I've actually just temporarily closed my XRP shorts position for the time being

calls.condition: If breakout confirmed and holds above ~124, next target ~143-146.
calls.reason: Testing 119-124 resistance; daily bearish divergence not reconfirmed so both short and long term look more bullish than bearish.
calls.quote: right now the price of Salana both in the short term and the longer term is still looking much more bullish than it is bearish

calls.condition: If breakout above 14.10-14.30 confirmed, next target 16.70-16.80.
calls.reason: Struggling at 14.10-14.30 resistance; larger bullish structure intact.
calls.quote: the next major target or point of resistance to watch out for would be sitting at approximately 1670 to 1680

notes: US market 'opens back up in less than a day' and Friday's close referenced, so dated Sunday 2026-09-27 (listing 09-28).
